04 / About AMYO

Trust is built.
Every day.

We are AMYO Construction Finishing Services, led by owner and general manager Wilmer G. Orlaza and based in Rodriguez (Montalban), Rizal.

Our portfolio brings together residential improvements, commercial interiors, specialist building services and construction support. Commitment, cooperation and care for the client guide the work we take on.

Our mission

To become the preferred contractor through a culture of trust built on commitment, cooperation, client satisfaction and value creation.

Our vision

To be a recognizable name in construction, known for quality and innovation, while supporting our team and the communities where we operate.

    Good to know

    Before we begin.

    What kinds of projects can I enquire about?+

    Residential, commercial, institutional and specialist construction work. The portfolio includes renovations, electrical and mechanical works, structural and masonry support, roofing, waterproofing and finishing. Share your scope so AMYO can confirm suitability.

    Where does AMYO work?+

    AMYO is based in Rodriguez (Montalban), Rizal. The company profile records work across Metro Manila and locations including Rizal, Pampanga, Laguna, Batangas and Davao. Availability for your location should be confirmed directly.

    Do I need complete plans to get in touch?+

    You can start with a description of the property and what you want to change. Tell us if plans or specifications are available. AMYO can discuss what further information is needed to assess the work.

    Can I request the company profile and documents?+

    Download the company profile here. Contact AMYO for supporting company documents and confirmation of current validity.

    Is submitting an enquiry a commitment?+

    No. Your enquiry starts a discussion. Scope, pricing, scheduling and any agreement need to be confirmed directly with AMYO.
